name: io.github.rascal-3/chainanalyzer-mcp
description: Blockchain AML for AI agents: risk scoring, sanctions, tx & bridge tracing across 12 chains.

environmentVariables.name: CHAINANALYZER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ChainAnalyzer API key (tfk_...) for subscription billing (Pro plan or higher). Use this or X402_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet private key used to sign x402 USDC micropayments (pay-per-request mode, no account needed). Use this or CHAINANALYZER_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: x402 payment network: base (default) or solana

environmentVariables.name: CHAINANALYZER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://chain-analyzer.com)
